_comment: TDD M4 reverse named-effort slice: with reasoning.supported=false the client asked for no thinking and the model does not think, so 'none' is removed exactly (no loss, no upstream field). Future-expected (source: reasoning.py disable-first + supported=false strip). RED on baseline: hard refusal 400, zero upstream IO. Contrast with supported_false_effort_strict.
name: m4_reasoning_responses_chat_supported_false_none_exact
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "bridge-resp"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"

[capabilities.overrides."bridge-resp".reasoning]
supported = false
